subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers keep repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR instead?
rationale: Multiple candidate PRs target the same bug, and this branch still has code blockers plus a contributor proof gap, so the canonical landing branch needs maintainer coordination.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the embedded parser fix, native Telegram coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Promote a broader sibling fix
options.body: If maintainers prefer a sibling with broader renderer coverage and proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the canonical fix is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the embedded parser fix, native Telegram coverage, and real prompt proof before treating it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on the one-shot approval semantics introduced through the command planner and how that reason should flow through approval renderers.
